sources.title: Exclusive: CarDekho parent to convert into public company ahead of IPO
CarDekho Parent Set to Become Public Company Ahead of IPO

synopsis: CarDekho Group is converting its parent entity, Girnar Software Private Limited, into a public company named Girnar Software Limited ahead of an anticipated initial public offering. Founded in 2008 by Amit Jain and Anurag Jain, the company reportedly plans to raise Rs 3,000 crore through an IPO consisting of a fresh issue and an offer-for-sale, targeting a valuation between Rs 13,000 crore and Rs 15,000 crore. The board has passed a special resolution for the name change, and the company has appointed Axis Bank, IIFL, Goldman Sachs, and Nomura as bankers for the proposed public issue. Existing investors include Peak XV Partners, Hillhouse Capital, CapitalG, and LeapFrog Investments. In FY25, the group reported consolidated operating revenue of Rs 2,795 crore and a net loss of Rs 266 crore.
